title: A galaxy in view
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Spiral galaxies have disks with spiral structures and typically contain stars, gas and dust. The Milky Way is a spiral galaxy, viewed from within its disk.

misconception: A learner may choose: Every star lies on one straight line
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: What is characteristic of a spiral galaxy?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: What is characteristic of a spiral galaxy? A disk with a spiral pattern. Spiral galaxies have disks with spiral structures and typically contain stars, gas and dust. The Milky Way is a spiral galaxy, viewed from within its disk.
Visual caption: A disk with spiral arms. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.

recall.question: What is characteristic of a spiral galaxy?
options: A disk with a spiral pattern
Every star lies on one straight line
It contains no gas or dust
recall.why: Spiral galaxies have disks with spiral structures and typically contain stars, gas and dust. The Milky Way is a spiral galaxy, viewed from within its disk.
